title: a visibility change runs before the method table is prepared, so mt_put dereferences NULL
live_proof: upstream fixed it in 94993eede (94993eedeea669204472113ec273f173c8f93945) (2026-08-21), which is in master and postdates the 4.0.0-rc2 pin (2026-03-12); the pin's tree has no such fix. Host ASan at the pin: a report my first pattern missed (with MRB_HEAP_PAGE_SIZE=1: a report my first pattern missed); the same case on master: no report
fidelity: the trigger is the Ruby test upstream added with its fix, extracted onto a self-contained harness that collects failures instead of aborting, so one script yields one verdict.
